title: thymus serpyllum subsp. glabrescens
intro: Thymus serpyllum subsp. glabrescens, commonly known as Wild Thyme, is a subspecies of perennial herb belonging to the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to boost the immune system and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Wild Thyme include its ability to act as an expectorant, antispasmodic, and antiseptic, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Wild Thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
